title: For each migration status among instances on host blaze8-12 th
question: For each migration status among instances on host blaze8-12 that have a completed migration, return the migration status and the maximum number of distinct (non-deleted) instances (grouped by display name and VM state) that have the system metadata key image_image_type for any instance participating in that status. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH completed_instances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.uuid
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
    AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.deleted = 0
),
status_groups AS (
  SELECT
    m.status AS migration_status,
    i.display_name,
    i.vm_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS distinct_instance_count
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  JOIN completed_instances ci ON ci.uuid = i.uuid
  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.deleted = 0
    AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
  GROUP BY m.status, i.display_name, i.vm_state
)
SELECT
  migration_status,
  MAX(distinct_instance_count) AS max_distinct_instances
FROM status_groups
GROUP BY migration_status
ORDER BY migration_status;
